Grace thanked Leo for the honest advice. The shopping list looked quieter than usual that evening. Grace wrote down every idea in a small notebook. Carrie sewed a blue dress for the play.

The experience taught Grace more than any book could. Grace ordered dumplings and juice at the shopping mall last night. There are always more possibilities than we expect. Best of all, bargain hunters arrive at opening time.

On Tuesday evenings, Grace reviews the notes from class. Leo advised Grace to try dancing as a new hobby. Grace bought a coat online because it was much cheaper. The chemist compared aqueous and alcohol based solutions.

People around Grace often share different ideas about the shopping list. The shopping mall has become an important part of daily life. Leo always says that small steps matter more than big plans. Maxwell won the school spelling bee this year.
Little by little, things began to change. At first, Grace found it difficult to keep the habit. There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right.
